author: MayeulQ
description:
MODMask All Cities UHI
	

Web-ready urban heat island products generated with MOD_Mask.
The dataset contains:

GHSL city catalogue and geometries
AROME grid-cell geometries
city-to-grid membership
MOD_Mask diagnostics
monthly mean UHI
mean diurnal UHI cycle

Available UHI definitions:

UHI_px
UHI_LR100
UHI_LR200
UHI_LR300
UHI_LR500

author: MayeulQ
description:
MODMask All Cities Rural Reference Masks
	

This dataset contains web-ready rural-reference masks associated with
MOD_Mask urban heat island calculations for GHSL urban centres within
the ALPX3 simulation domain.

	
		
	
	
		MOD_Mask version
	

MOD_Mask v2.0.1.

	
		
	
	
		Rural-reference definitions
	

The repository provides rural-reference information for:

UHI_px
UHI_LR100
UHI_LR200
UHI_LR300
UHI_LR500

description:
MODMask Selected Cities — v2.0.2
	

This dataset contains city-scale products generated using
MOD_Mask v2.0.2 for six selected European cities:

Dijon
Geneva
Grenoble
Lyon
Paris
Toulouse


	
		
	
	
		New in v2.0.2
	

MOD_Mask v2.0.2 extends the previous selected-city products by providing
the temperature fields associated with the urban and rural-reference
masks used in the UHI methodology.
